Designed as the ultimate hub for power, data, audio, video, and connectivity, this advanced docking station brings together everything you need for high‑performance productivity. Whether you're a creative professional, business user, or tech enthusiast, enjoy effortless integration for laptops, displays, peripherals, and more‑all from a single, sleek device.Featuring cutting‑edge dual HDMI® ports, the docking station supports up to 4K@60 video output per port, delivering stunning clarity for multitasking and multimedia applications. DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode ensures compatibility with the latest host devices, and HDCP™ support helps protect your content.Expand your connectivity with seven versatile USB data ports, including ultra‑fast USB‑C Gen 2 and USB‑A Gen 2 options that deliver up to 10Gbps of bandwidth. For reliable wired networking, the built‑in Gigabit Ethernet port delivers stable connections. Effortlessly transfer files using the dual SD™ and microSD™ card slots, and enjoy high‑quality audio playback and recording through the 3.5mm audio jack.
